dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are present across the mid-dorsal region. The most prominent structures exhibit a sharp, high-contrast gradient from a dark outer perimeter to a light grey interior, with jagged, non-linear edge transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the lower lateral flank and posterior dorsal region. These clusters appear as asymmetrical, bright patches lacking the internal gradient found in the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central-upper dorsal area form an obtuse scalene triangle. The spatial relationship between the primary central 'O' ring and the two adjacent posterior 'C' rings defines a wide-angle V-shaped orientation.
